stitch_prompt: Redesign Familstorm's capability landing page into a modern, enterprise-grade dark-themed portal (deep obsidian background #0B0F19, electric blue #2563EB, cyber cyan #38BDF8 accent, slate cards #1E293B with subtle frosted border lighting). Sections in exact order: 1. Hero with glowing gradient title 'Familstorm — AI-Driven Development', pill badge 'Autonomous Engineering Studio', lead copy on multi-agent deterministic pipelines, primary glowing CTA buttons, and trust metrics. 2. Overview section detailing the 2-3 senior specialist core human ratio and autonomous operating model across 3 glass cards. 3. AI Agent Architecture section featuring an interactive tiered diagram showing AM/PC and TL orchestration down to Designer, Frontend, Backend, Game Dev, QA, and DevOps agents with rigid boundary checks. 4. Delivery Pipeline P0-P8 displaying an 8-phase timeline track and an AI vs Human contribution progress matrix. 5. Selected Project Showcase highlighting Phuong Tri Enterprise Platform and Modular Game System with technical tags and production metrics. 6. Velocity & Quality Metrics with 2.5x-3x speedup banner, comparison bar charts vs traditional development, and 5 sequential review gates. 7. Collaboration Models presenting 4 engagement tiers (Dedicated Pod AI-ODC, Turnkey System, Co-Dev JV, Strategic Investment) across cards. 8. Contact & Footer with direct telephone, email, GitHub links, and clean copyright. Optimized for Next.js and Tailwind CSS with responsive mobile reflow.
